name: AgentMail
summary: Email inboxes for AI agents via API: create inboxes, send, receive, search threads and manage calendars; hosted MCP server with 47 tools.
description: REST API and SDKs for programmatic inboxes with threads, labels, attachments (with extracted PDF/DOCX text), drafts and scheduled send, allow/block lists, calendars, webhooks and websockets. The hosted MCP server at `https://mcp.agentmail.to/mcp` exposes 47 tools (plus 2 organization tools under OAuth) and publishes a `message.received` MCP Event. AgentID tools let an agent create accounts at third-party apps using an inbox as its identity. Pricing (Oct 2026): Free $0 (3 inboxes, 3,000 emails/month, 100/day, 'Sent via AgentMail' footer), Developer $20/month, Startup $200/month, Enterprise custom.

agent_access.notes: API keys (prefix am_) from console.agentmail.to; for MCP send them as the x-api-key header, or use OAuth in Claude/ChatGPT. Stdio bridges: `npx -y agentmail-mcp` or `uvx agentmail-mcp`. The MCP repo is MIT; the service is proprietary.
